headline: Bitcoin Holds Above $81,400 Support Level Amid Market Pressure
summary: Bitcoin held near the $81,400 support price level as selling pressure mounted across global digital asset markets.
why: Bitcoin is the largest digital currency by market value, serving as a liquidity benchmark for crypto assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Sustained selling pressure tested technical price support thresholds.

why_moved: Increased bearish trading volume pushed Bitcoin prices toward the $81,400 support level.
